name: fact_selection
label: Fact selection
description: Picks one fact set every model in a group already knows, spread evenly across relations, so causal traces of those models are compared on the same facts. Launched from the Knowledge localisation page.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Fact set name
fields.note: the run name, and the folder the set is written to

fields.name: models
fields.label: Models
fields.note: comma-separated; the set keeps only facts all of them know

fields.name: formats
fields.label: Formats
fields.note: comma-separated; a fact must be known in every one (chat_* only by the instruct models)

fields.name: instruct_models
fields.label: Instruct models
fields.note: the models also held to the chat_* formats

fields.name: groups
fields.label: Groups
fields.note: 'name:model,model;...': one set per group from the facts its models share. Empty: one set over all models.

options.label: all records (tracing only: it locates, it does not pick a setting)

fields.name: max_candidates
fields.label: Candidates to score
fields.note: sample at most this many facts, evenly across relations/domains, before scoring (0 = all)
